profileLabel: Center-left economics; mixed on electoral institutions
summary: Laguna 4th District representative who authored caregiver, nutrition and tertiary-education assistance bills and women's-safety measures. Pairs an anti-dynasty bill with bills postponing barangay elections and extending terms.
caveat: Anti-dynasty and election-postponement bills point in opposite directions; the institutions score is low confidence. Only bill filings were reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Principal author of caregiver assistance, feeding and tertiary subsidies; co-author of minimum wage and gig-worker protections (left), offset by co-authored VAT exemption on electricity and travel-tax abolition (market-leaning). Bills only; no votes reviewed.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB05088, HB05562, HB08476, HB08081, HB06572, HB05205, HB08464 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Only gender-equality evidence (Safe Spaces Act amendments, VAWP, TFVAW bills); a second issue is needed.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB05564, HB08393, HB11264 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Principal author of anti-dynasty bill (HB08389) but also of bills postponing the 2026 barangay elections to 2028 and fixing five-year terms (HB10591, HB10924, HB10971), which extend incumbents. Contradiction preserved; score near center.
